$comment: Pins every skill vendored under .github/skills/ (synced into .claude/skills/ by scripts/sync-claude-skills.sh) to a specific version and content checksum, verified by scripts/check-harness.ts (`npm run harness:check`). Scope is deliberately limited to .github/skills/ — the skills this repo authors and owns; the .claude/skills/speckit-* skills are installed and versioned by the spec-kit tool itself (see .specify/integration.json's own `version` field), not by this manifest. Regenerate a skill's sha256 with `npm run harness:check` after bumping its SKILL.md `version` field — it prints the actual hash on mismatch.
